findings.title: Preserve right alignment of small-action controls
findings.body: Making `.small-action` a flex container leaves `.small-action-desc` at the default `flex: 0 1 auto`, so short descriptions no longer fill the row. The existing `button { float: right; }` consequently cannot keep controls at the row's right edge: nested buttons float within the content-width description, while direct flex-item buttons ignore the float. Controls move next to short messages instead. Give the description flex growth or replace the float with a flex-compatible auto margin.

findings.title: Provide right alignment for the legacy box fallbacks
findings.body: The new `flexbox()` mixin selects `display: -webkit-box` or `display: -moz-box` in browsers that only support the legacy box model, such as Safari 6. Those implementations resolve auto margins to zero rather than using them to absorb free space. With `float: right` removed and no child using `box-flex`, the header panel sits immediately beside the logo or topic information instead of at the right edge. Add an equivalent legacy alignment mechanism or retain the previous layout for those browsers.
